title: How is Mao Zedong connected to Shrek?
description:
A 1975 handshake in Beijing, an Oval Office meeting and a White House concert connect Mao Zedong to Shrek.

Mao Zedong → Henry Kissinger → Barack Obama → Mike Myers → Shrek

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
